label: FP
reason: Although user input flows to the response writer, the operation bar.toCharArray() converts the string to a char array. When passed to PrintWriter.println(), this invokes String.valueOf(char[]), which outputs a string representation of the array (e.g., [c@...]) rather than the original string content, thereby mitigating the XSS risk.

evidence.note: ternary ensures param flow, but toCharArray prevents string reflection
